title: November Twenty-Six — EN/IT/PT (Pete McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian Portuguese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
November twenty-six, the year was good
A baby came into the neighbourhood
Biggest one we'd seen in quite some time
Wilma said — this boy is going to be fine

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Gli anni passarono, crebbe nelle sue scarpe [Years went by, he grew into his boots]
Il figlio maggiore non ha bisogno di carte [The oldest son doesn't need the papers]
Rugby d'inverno, sole sulla baia [Rugby in winter, sun on the bay]
Cinquant'anni e più ma sempre lo stesso, ogni giornata [Fifty-something now but always the same, every day]

[Chorus — English]
November twenty-six, raise a glass
To the one who always showed the rest what class
Pete Capitán, the first one through the door
Happy birthday to the one who set the floor

[Bridge — Português]
Vinte e seis de novembro — levante um copo [November twenty-six — raise a glass]
Ao filho mais velho que nunca foi frouxo [To the oldest son who was never slack]
Pete Capitán, sempre na frente [Pete Capitán, always at the front]
Feliz aniversário — para o nosso parente [Happy birthday — to our family member]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pelican out on the water calm and sure
Same man every morning, nothing to prove more

[Outro — EN/IT/PT]
Happy birthday Pete
Buon compleanno Pete [Happy birthday Pete]
Feliz aniversário Pete [Happy birthday Pete]
That's my boy
